purpose: Govern paid/time-consuming SkillGen Table 1 full-matrix execution without changing claim verdicts or running benchmarks.

known_observed_entry_cost.wall_time_observation: train plus eval took on the order of tens of minutes per overnight operation log

cost_units.token_usage: total input plus output tokens as reported by SkillGen token_usage artifacts
cost_units.time: wall_time_seconds per entry and per run tier
cost_units.money: estimated USD when provider pricing is available; pricing source and timestamp required
cost_units.entry: one table1_row::paper_model execution including training and held-out eval

preflight_loader_only.purpose: Load configs, datasets, route mappings, and output directories without API benchmark execution.

one_entry_smoke.purpose: Run exactly one table1_row::paper_model entry to validate evidence flow, cost metadata, and stop policy.
one_entry_smoke.claim_impact: entry-level evidence only; aggregate Table 1 claims remain blocked unless explicitly scoped

openai_routes_only.purpose: Run only entries whose provider_route_id starts with openai/ and whose direct OpenAI fallback is approved.
openai_routes_only.claim_impact: partial_matrix unless all paper routes are intentionally scoped out and reported as provider-limited

one_benchmark_all_models.purpose: Run one Table 1 benchmark row across all eight paper model routes.
requires_before_start: provider availability check for all eight routes
stop threshold for deprecated skills and provider errors
one_benchmark_all_models.claim_impact: can support row-level evidence; cannot support full Table 1 aggregate claims alone

full_80_entry_matrix.purpose: Run the complete 10-row by 8-model Table 1 matrix.
requires_before_start: all rows execution-ready or explicitly labeled reconstructed
provider availability confirmed for all routes
full_80_entry_matrix.claim_impact: only this tier can support full Table 1 aggregate verdict changes after parsed results and comparison exist

provider_error.trigger: authentication, billing, unavailable model, OpenRouter HTTP 402, or repeated provider rate limits
provider_error.required_action: stop affected tier, preserve logs, record provider and route, request human decision before retry or fallback

token_budget_exceeded.trigger: entry, tier, or full-run token budget is reached or projected to be exceeded
token_budget_exceeded.required_action: stop before launching additional entries; write partial matrix cost report
token_budget_exceeded.claim_impact: partial_matrix or budget_stopped, not claim failure

repeated_deprecated_skills.trigger: configured threshold of consecutive deprecated or failed-gate skills within a row/tier
repeated_deprecated_skills.required_action: pause and inspect configs, verification gate, prompt, and dataset before spending more
repeated_deprecated_skills.claim_impact: executed entries may be negative evidence; unrun entries remain incomplete

missing_trajectory_artifacts.trigger: required verification or held-out trajectory files are absent
missing_trajectory_artifacts.required_action: stop parsing as valid full-matrix evidence until trajectory retention is repaired or deviation is approved

missing_token_usage.trigger: train or eval token usage artifacts are missing
missing_token_usage.required_action: stop cost aggregation and label entry cost metadata incomplete
missing_token_usage.claim_impact: cost governance incomplete; claim verdict cannot be cost-qualified

unexpected_cost_spike.trigger: combined token usage exceeds approved threshold or configured multiplier over baseline
unexpected_cost_spike.required_action: stop additional entries in that row/model family and request budget review

report_labels.exact_author_original: Author-original runner, split, config, route, and comparison rule were used.
report_labels.reconstructed_low_cost: Reduced or reconstructed path used for cost-controlled evidence flow; cannot support exact paper-level reproduction.
report_labels.reconstructed_full_scale: Reconstructed path run at full intended scale; can support partial evidence if positive, not exact reproduction unless equivalence is proven.
report_labels.provider_fallback: Provider path differs from the originally planned route, such as direct OpenAI fallback after OpenRouter failure.
report_labels.partial_matrix: Only a subset of the 80 Table 1 entries ran; aggregate full-matrix claims remain incomplete.

missing_metadata_needed_from_c_group: per-tier approved token and dollar budget
retry linkage between failed and successful attempts
non_goals: Do not run benchmarks from this policy.
Do not implement the full-matrix runner here.
Do not change claim verdicts based on budget governance alone.
Do not label partial or reconstructed execution as exact reproduction.
